note: Tier-3 threat deck: 11 cards (3 Universal, 3 Military, Military + Economic, and one each led by Influence, Cyber, Economic, Grid). Late squeeze: tier 3 is dealt only by stage-III Militarist events, so rounds 10-11 (9-11 at difficulty 2+). Values are sane starting points, not tuned. Each counter option is a list of items, all paid in full (pooled); the players pay one option. Value method on every card: harm = per-player harm x 1.5 (about 1.5 players near) + shared harm (compute, sway, pieces placed, sites), against the counter at the anchors; each value line gives the ratio against the cheapest option and against the credits option. A sacrificed tag prices 5 (3 tags 15); a sway or a Unity pull prices 4; a troop prices 9 (5 plus its strike). The unprinted 1 sway every uncountered threat makes is left out of every value.

cards.name: Last Ultimatum
cards.text: Each player near it pays 20 credits or loses 2 nodes near it (never their last). Deal 1 extra tier-2 threat in this country; it executes next round.

effects.why: lose_node_or takes 1 node today; a count field lets it take 2 (still never a last node)
deals the extra threat now, at the named tier, into this country; it executes next round

cards.value: counter 15 (credits) / 16 (4 ambassadors) / 15 (3 tags); harm per player near min(20 credits, 2 nodes 12) = 12 x 1.5 = 18, plus an extra tier-2 threat ~10 shared = 28; ratio 1.9 against the cheapest (15, credits or 3 tags), 1.9 against the credits (15)
cards.check: Bites rounds 10-11 (9-11 at difficulty 2+), when 2 nodes are a scoring loss and 20 credits is most of a round (harsher than tier-2 Manhunt's 14); a Military or Influence engine, or any seat with 15 spare credits, answers it; the extra threat is dealt now and executes next round, so no chain within a round; no loop.
flags: deal_threats tier and scope fields (a threat that deals a threat deals it now, into its own country, at a named tier; it executes next round)

a plain discard of N cards for each player near it; requisition with amount 0 would let them pay 0 instead, so it can't stand in

cards.value: counter 15 (credits) / 18 (4 energy) / 18 (3 cubes) / 15 (3 tags); harm per player near 1 card 4 x 1.5 = 6, plus shared 15 credits (one seat) and 4 compute 8 = 29; ratio 1.9 against the cheapest (15, credits or 3 tags), 1.9 against the credits (15)

the location's base makes 2 extra corp troops at once, past the base's cap (more war, more Discord)

cards.value: counter 14 (credits) / 13.5 (3 energy) / 15 (3 tags) / 15 (6 credits + 2 energy); harm shared a second war step on the front ~12 (a second round of cancelling and factory strikes), plus 2 corp troops ~6 and sway 4 = 22; ratio 1.6 against the cheapest (13.5, 3 energy), 1.6 against the credits (14)
